name: Scalloped Riwaq
summary: A broad, scalloped mosque with a large horseshoe entrance and one integrated stepped minaret.
why: The scalloped roof is the architectural silhouette itself. Three large openings carve a deep arcade through one connected mass. The central horseshoe opening and crown share x=51; both side openings mirror that axis at 35.8 and 66.2. The right minaret overlaps the facade and shares its baseline.
risk: The bulbous roof is deliberately ornamental and more expressive than a conventional dome. At 24 px the broad horseshoe entrance and single tower carry the identity.
sub1: Deep lobes shape the building itself
